introspectum.lead: A symbolic piece about an inner journey: an eye at the centre of a spiral, phases of the moon, butterflies and deep red and emerald tones. About self-discovery, awareness and the change that happens when we stay inside the process.
story: We go in circles not because we are lost, but because some lessons return until we understand them more deeply.
The spiral is a path inward where every turn leads a little deeper. The eye is awareness looking at that path. The moon phases and butterflies are cycles and transformation.
What keeps repeating in your life? Which patterns return asking to be understood more deeply? This work is not about quick answers but about staying present in the process where real change happens.
introspectum.meaning: Some lessons return until we understand them more deeply. A piece about the inner journey along a spiral, awareness and the change that happens inside the process.
introspectum.seo: symbolic art with an eye and a spiral about the inner journey

a-thousand-moments-later.lead: The smallest moments can change a day, the smallest days can change a life. A girl walks through a series of arches, each one a metaphor for such a moment: they never repeat and each opens a new space, a new state. It is neither escape nor search, but a way of living. A thousand moments later you are no longer who you were.
story: “The smallest moments can change a day, the smallest days can change a life.”

This work is about the thousands of tiny moments we barely notice. They do not seem important and have no obvious meaning, yet something inside us shifts because of them, quietly and almost invisibly. A person is changed not by one defining moment but by countless ones that pass unnoticed, stay with us and slowly transform who we become.

The girl moves through a series of arches, and each is a visual metaphor for such a moment. The arches change and never repeat: each opens a new space, a new atmosphere, a new state. Her movement is neither flight nor search, but a way of living. She does not stop to understand what is changing her, yet with every passage something in her no longer returns to where it was before. The arches become points of quiet, irreversible transformation.

These moments often seem simple: a warm embrace that lasts a second longer; a smile that changes the whole day; a silent walk without a goal; a short conversation after which something finally falls into place. There is no drama in them, but there is presence, and it is presence that changes us. Only with distance do you see clearly that it was not one moment that changed you, but everything that lived between them.
A thousand moments later… you are no longer who you were.

Remember the moments that stayed with you, not the biggest ones but those that quietly shaped you. This work invites you to reflect on your own path and notice how much of who you are today was born in the in-between.
a-thousand-moments-later.meaning: A thousand moments later you are no longer who you were. A piece about the small moments we barely notice that quietly and irreversibly change us.
a-thousand-moments-later.seo: surreal art: a girl in a red dress walks through arches

creation.lead: A visual meditation on the beauty and mystery of creation. The woman and the wolf are not opposites here but parts of one design, and dark flowers, deep shadows and warm amber light create a cinematic atmosphere of stillness and contemplation.
story: This work is about the quiet harmony woven into the world: a delicate balance between strength and elegance, wildness and awareness, form and spirit.
The surreal composition explores the deep, often hidden connection between human intuition and primal instinct.

The wolf is inner strength, origin and the quiet guardian within us. The figure is a symbol of awareness and continuous transformation. The atmosphere of dark flowers, deep shadows and warm amber glints creates a mysterious, timeless world.
This is not just a print but an invitation to pause, look deeper and feel your own inner strength.
creation.meaning: The woman and the wolf are not opposites but parts of one design: intuition and instinct, strength and elegance. A piece about the harmony of creation and the quiet inner strength that lives in each of us.
creation.seo: surreal portrait of a woman with a wolf among dark flowers

natural-light.lead: A surreal portrait about how light often enters our lives exactly where we feel most protected, until that protection cracks. A split helmet, butterflies and warm golden light form a contemplative story about healing and inner awakening.
story: “There is a crack in everything. That’s how the light gets in.”
The work is inspired by words often attributed to Leonard Cohen and reflects on the illusion of protection we build around ourselves.

The cracked helmet is the protection we create through identity, control and external structures: it is meant to keep us safe but can also isolate us. When the helmet cracks, warm golden light flows in, and vulnerability turns out not to be weakness but discovery.
The butterflies symbolise transformation and renewal: real change begins not when we are fully protected, but when we let something genuine reach us.
What do you use as protection, and what will happen when it finally cracks?
natural-light.meaning: “There is a crack in everything; that’s how the light gets in.” A piece about vulnerability as discovery, the opening through which healing and change enter life.
natural-light.seo: surreal portrait in a cracked helmet with butterflies

open-my-eyes.lead: A surreal portrait about perception beyond sight: betta fish and roses partly hide the face and invite you to look deeper. Emerald and copper tones, layered detail and a quiet tension between the visible and the real.
story: “If you decide to believe only what you see, you have also decided to be blind to everything you don’t see.”
We often trust only what is visible: what can be measured, explained or proven. But some of the most important things in life were never meant to be seen with the eyes.
This work is about the quiet tension between what is visible and what is real. The face, partly hidden and transformed, is not a limitation but an invitation to look deeper.

The betta fish are flowing movement and a veil before the eyes: thoughts and intuitions that colour how we see the world. The flowers are inner growth, intuition and the blossoming of emotional depth.
Sometimes what we call blindness is only the moment before we truly begin to see. Perhaps the real question is not “What do I see?” but “What am I still refusing to see?”
open-my-eyes.meaning: True vision begins where sight ends. A piece about intuition, the invisible layers of reality and the courage to look at what we have refused to see.
open-my-eyes.seo: surreal female portrait with betta fish and flowers

becoming-the-swan.lead: A symbolic surreal work about self-discovery: the moment perception shifts and we begin to see ourselves not through doubt but through truth. A refined, deep accent that adds emotion, elegance and focus to an interior.
story: The work is inspired by the story of the Ugly Duckling and explores a quiet but life-changing realisation.
When did the Ugly Duckling stop feeling ugly? When it realised it was a swan.

Each of us carries something unique inside: a hidden identity, a deeper truth waiting to be recognised. Until we realise it, we keep searching outside, trying to become who we already are. We seem to be “treading water”: doubting, comparing, hesitating, not because something is missing but because we have not yet seen it clearly.
This work is about the moment of recognition, when nothing changes outside and everything changes within. Identity here is not something we build but something we discover.
becoming-the-swan.meaning: The Ugly Duckling stopped being ugly when it realised it was a swan. A piece about the moment of recognising yourself: nothing changes outside, everything changes within.
becoming-the-swan.seo: surreal female portrait with black swans

rise-from-the-ashes.lead: A symbolic work inspired by Ukraine’s resilience during the Russian-Ukrainian war. A female figure among fire, a sunflower, butterflies and white doves: an image of rebirth, hope, peace and the unbreakable human spirit.
story: “Even when everything around seems to be falling apart, there is a quiet strength inside that keeps creating new life.”
The work was created in one of the darkest moments of Ukraine’s recent history and reflects the resilience, courage and spiritual strength that appear in times of destruction and uncertainty.

At the centre is a solitary female figure lit by a glow resembling a sunflower, a symbol deeply tied to Ukraine and its vital force. Flames, butterflies, wings and white doves swirl around her. Fire is both destruction and purification, the sunflower’s glow is hope shining even in darkness. The butterflies symbolise transformation and renewal, the dove peace and healing.
This work is not only about war but about the profound human ability to endure, change and rebuild.
rise-from-the-ashes.meaning: Even when everything is destroyed, there is a strength inside that creates life again. A work born during the war, about Ukraine’s unbreakable spirit, hope and rebirth.
rise-from-the-ashes.seo: symbolic art about Ukraine: a phoenix, a sunflower and a dove of peace

honor-him.lead: A Christian work about the sacrifice of Jesus: the face of Christ in a crown of thorns among deep reds and dark teal. A spiritual accent for a home or prayer space, about healing, reconciliation and a love that has already built the bridge.
story: The cross is a bridge between humanity and God, built not by our efforts but by His love.
The crown of thorns is the pain He took upon Himself. Deep red is the price of this love, dark teal the silence and peace that come after it.
Where in your life do you feel broken, distant or in need of restoration? This work is not only to look at but to return to. A reminder that the bridge has already been built.
honor-him.meaning: The cross is a bridge between humanity and God, built by His love. A work about the sacrifice of Christ, healing and hope for anyone who feels broken.
honor-him.seo: Christian art with Jesus in a crown of thorns

face-the-sun.lead: A girl among sunflowers, butterflies and birds in warm golden light and deep blues: a symbol of faith, inner direction and the conscious choice to move toward the light. A work that brings warmth, hope and spiritual depth into a home.
story: “Many flowers open to the sun, but only one constantly follows it. Heart, be a sunflower: not only open to God’s blessing but constantly turned toward Him.”

There is a difference between receiving the light and living turned toward it. This work is about a heart that does not simply open when light appears but chooses again and again to stay turned toward God: not only in moments of clarity but in uncertainty, silence and seasons when the light feels far away.

The sunflower becomes more than a symbol: a reflection of devotion, a life consciously directed toward Him. We are all rooted in this world, in its struggles, fears and limitations, but we were not created to be defined by them.
Transformation is not only receiving God’s blessing but also where we choose to turn our heart.
face-the-sun.meaning: Heart, be a sunflower: not only open to the light but constantly turned toward God. A work about faith, devotion and the daily choice to walk toward the light.
face-the-sun.seo: art with a girl and sunflowers about faith

in-his-image.lead: A maximalist surreal collage: a female portrait among fragments of classical sculpture, architecture, butterflies and birds. A work about human identity as a reflection of the Creator and about finding ourselves in the images that inspire us.
story: “Created in His image, we search the world to remember who we are.”

“In His Image” is a visual exploration of the idea that our identity is reflected in the beauty, stories and symbols we surround ourselves with. It is a tribute to the human soul as a reflection of the highest Creator.

Classical fragments, ancient sculptures and architecture, symbolise shared cultural heritage and the timeless search for perfection and truth. Living symbols, butterflies and birds, stand for the soul’s freedom, transformation and the spark of life in every creation. Layers of identity: the complex collage shows how our self is assembled from memory, art and the images that inspire us.
The central portrait becomes a point of reflection and invites the viewer to see themselves inside these symbols.
This is not just a print but an invitation to pause, look within and remember the dignity and creativity that live in every person.
in-his-image.meaning: We are made in His image and look for ourselves in the beauty, stories and symbols around us. A work about human dignity, creativity and the memory of Who created us.
in-his-image.seo: surreal portrait collage with classical sculptures and butterflies

lion-and-lamb.lead: A Christian work inspired by the biblical image of Christ as the Lion of Judah and the Lamb of God: strength and sacrifice, authority and innocence, revealed in the story of salvation. A meaningful spiritual accent for a home, prayer space or church.
story: The work reflects one of the deepest paradoxes of the Gospel. Christ appears at once as the Lion of Judah, mighty, commanding, victorious, and as the Lamb of God, gentle, innocent, sacrificial.

Through His death on the cross these two realities meet in one moment of salvation. The lion symbolises God’s authority and victory over darkness, the lamb humility, purity and the highest sacrifice for humanity.
Around them are symbols of faith: butterflies, fragments of Scripture, heavenly light and a dove descending from above. The composition invites reflection on the love, power and grace of Christ.
A reminder that the same God who holds the highest authority chose humility and sacrifice to bring salvation to the world.
lion-and-lamb.meaning: Christ is both the Lion of Judah and the Lamb of God: strength and sacrifice, authority and humility. A work about a love that chose the cross to bring salvation to the world.
lion-and-lamb.seo: Christian art: the Lion of Judah and the Lamb of God

miracle.lead: A black-and-white symbolic portrait about the quiet miracle hidden in every human life. A child’s calm gaze, tropical leaves, a pelican guardian and fragile butterflies: a contemplative work that adds depth, stillness and mystery to an interior.
story: “Sometimes the miracle we are waiting for is already looking through our eyes.”
The composition combines a child’s calm gaze, tropical leaves, a pelican and fragile butterflies: natural images of protection, transformation, innocence and spiritual awareness.

The pelican is a symbol of care and strength. The butterflies stand for transformation and the fragile beauty of life. Among deep shadows and organic textures the child’s presence feels both timeless and deeply human.
The monochrome removes everything unnecessary and focuses attention on emotion, symbol and atmosphere.
Perhaps the miracles we look for in the world already live quietly within us.
miracle.meaning: The miracle we are waiting for is often already looking through our eyes. A work about innocence, care and the quiet wonder that lives in every human life.
miracle.seo: black-and-white portrait of a child with a pelican and butterflies

while-im-waiting.lead: A calm and powerful white tiger in a glowing arch among flowers and warm light: a visual reflection on patience, inner strength and trust in the process of becoming. An accent that brings calm, depth and quiet confidence to a bedroom, studio or study.
story: “What we are waiting for is not as important as what happens to us while we wait. Trust the process.”
We often believe life will begin when something finally changes: a door opens, an answer comes, everything falls into place. But life is already happening, right here, in the waiting.

The white tiger stands still, not from hesitation but from presence. Around it are beauty, light and life, and it does not rush ahead but stands firmly where it is. There is strength here, but not a loud one; there is movement, but an invisible one. Because the deepest changes rarely happen on the surface.
Waiting is not emptiness but preparation. The process does not postpone your life; it shapes it.
Sometimes the strongest thing you can do is not rush forward but stay, trust and grow where you are.
while-im-waiting.meaning: What matters is not what we wait for but what happens to us while we wait. A work about patience, trust in the process and a strength that has no need to hurry.
while-im-waiting.seo: art with a white tiger in a glowing arch

look-inside.lead: A surreal portrait of a blindfolded woman among flowers, butterflies and symbolic images: a powerful visual reflection on inner vision, self-awareness and awakening. An accent that adds depth, mystery and meaning to an interior.
story: “Your vision will become clear only when you can look into your own heart. Who looks outside, dreams; who looks inside, awakens.” (Carl Gustav Jung)
We spend so much time looking outward: seeking answers in the world, trying to understand who we are through what we see. But clarity was never meant to come from outside.

The blindfold here is not a limitation but a conscious choice to stop looking outward and begin seeing within. Surrounded by symbols of time, beauty and transformation, the figure stands on the threshold between illusion and truth. What we often call sight is only surface perception; true vision begins deeper.
Everything we search for was never outside us. Sometimes the moment you stop looking outward is the moment you finally begin to see.
look-inside.meaning: Who looks outside, dreams; who looks inside, awakens. A work about inner vision: everything we search for was never outside us.
look-inside.seo: surreal portrait of a blindfolded woman

friendship.lead: A surreal wildlife work about an unexpected moment of harmony and trust: a majestic tiger and a small brave squirrel among red roses. Warmth, mystery and a sense of wonder for a living room, study or bedroom.
story: “I have always believed that what unites us is stronger than what divides us.”

“Friendship” is a visual exploration of the idea that connection and understanding are possible even between the most different creatures. It is a tribute to the quiet power of trust and the beauty of coexistence.

The tiger and the squirrel are a metaphor for the balance between strength and fragility: true strength lies in the ability to be gentle, true courage in the readiness to trust. The red roses are passion and vitality, creating a safe space where even unexpected friends find peace. The butterflies are fleeting, fragile moments of harmony that stitch the world together.
An invitation to pause, admire the complexity of nature and be inspired by the unexpected connections that make life beautiful.
friendship.meaning: What unites us is stronger than what divides us. A work about trust between the most different creatures: true strength is being gentle, true courage is trusting.
friendship.seo: surreal portrait of a tiger with a squirrel and red roses

who-you-are.lead: A maximalist surreal work about the journey to yourself: a majestic deer in golden jewellery among tropical greenery and exotic birds. A visual meditation on the difference between social masks and our true essence.
story: “You find peace not when you rearrange the circumstances of your life, but when you realise who you are at the deepest level.”
“Who You Are” invites you to look through titles and ornaments and see the timeless spirit that remains unchanged.

The deer is a symbol of intuition, dignity and inner strength: calm amid the complexity of life, like the part of us that always stands on the ground. The jewellery and chains are the roles, statuses and identities the world places on us: they can look like a crown but become a burden when we forget the being beneath them. The tropical surroundings, lush greenery and exotic birds, are the living energy of intuition and freedom that opens when we are in harmony with ourselves.
An invitation to stop and remember the quiet strength that lives at the very core of your being.
who-you-are.meaning: Peace comes not from changing circumstances but from realising who you are. A work about the difference between social masks and the true essence that stays unchanged.
who-you-are.seo: surreal portrait of a deer in golden jewellery

depths.lead: A woman rises through deep ocean darkness among glowing jellyfish and warm golden light: a symbol of healing, inner change and beauty born through struggle. A work that brings emotional depth, warmth and reflection to a space.
story: “The most beautiful people we have known are those who have known defeat, suffering, struggle, loss… and have found their way out of the depths.”

There is a beauty that cannot be created on the surface. This work is about what is formed in the depths: in places we do not choose, in seasons we do not understand, in moments that change us from within. About the quiet change when a person passes through pain and does not lose the ability to feel, to care, to love.
The glowing jellyfish become more than light: they are moments of grace in the darkness. They do not remove the depth, they illuminate it.
“Beautiful people do not just happen.” They are formed slowly, deeply, honestly.
depths.meaning: The most beautiful people are those who passed through the depths and did not lose the ability to love. A work about healing and the beauty born of struggle.
depths.seo: surreal female portrait with jellyfish about healing

beautiful-things.lead: A symbolic work about quiet confidence: the kind that does not seek attention but naturally attracts it. A swan under a full moon, warm light in the dark and a moment of calm: a serene, refined accent that fills an interior with atmosphere and depth.
story: “Like the moon, beautiful things never beg for attention.”
True beauty does not have to announce itself. Like the moon, always visible yet never demanding attention, some things simply exist in their fullness.

The composition combines stillness and life: a swan, small creatures staying close, warm light in the dark, all in one moment of calm. It is a work about quiet confidence, natural beauty, presence without performance and inner peace.
A reminder that what is truly valuable does not have to prove anything: it simply is.
beautiful-things.meaning: Like the moon, beautiful things never beg for attention. A work about quiet confidence and a beauty that has nothing to prove: it simply is.
beautiful-things.seo: art with a swan under a full moon

introvert.lead: An owl in a carved frame among flowers and deep dark tones: a work about quiet strength, wisdom and a clarity that comes not from doing more but from seeing deeper.
story: Introversion is neither weakness nor detachment. It is a different way of being in the world: attentively, deeply, at your own pace.
The owl is an ancient symbol of wisdom and night vision: it notices what others miss in the rush. The frame around it is the inner space in which clarity is born.
What if strength does not have to be proven? What if clarity comes not from doing more but from seeing deeper? An invitation to slow down, observe and return to inner silence.
introvert.meaning: Strength does not have to be proven, and clarity comes from seeing deeper. A work about quiet wisdom and the value of your own rhythm.
introvert.seo: art with an owl about quiet strength

ataro.lead: A surreal female portrait: a butterfly covers one eye, surrounded by bright red flowers, deep blue and exotic birds. A bold emotional accent with dramatic colour contrast for a living room, bedroom or creative studio.
story: Some things cannot be explained, only felt.
“If I could say it in words, there would be no reason to paint.”

This work lives where language ends and expression begins. The composition combines opposites: beauty and mystery, softness and strength, silence and tension. The butterfly, partly covering the face, becomes a symbol of transformation, perception and the invisible layers of identity.
It is a work about expression beyond words, emotional depth, identity and inner change.
The most important truths are not spoken: they are lived.
ataro.meaning: If it could be said in words, there would be no reason to paint. A work about what lives beyond language: emotion, transformation and the invisible layers of identity.
ataro.seo: surreal female portrait with a butterfly

soul-awakening.lead: A dramatic surreal portrait about the moment the human spirit awakens through love and inner transformation. A female figure rises from waves of colour and light among red macaws and petals, a work that fills an interior with emotion, energy and movement.
story: “Touch my heart with hands of love. Only then can I truly bloom.”
The composition shows a powerful female figure rising from waves of colour and light. The red macaws and blooming petals symbolise freedom, vitality, passion and the courage to open the heart.

The explosive red palette creates a sense of movement and energy: emotional tension and spiritual rebirth at once. Like a phoenix rising through colour and motion, the figure embodies the moment when inner strength finally wakes up.
A work about love, transformation and the moment inner energy awakens.
soul-awakening.meaning: The heart blooms only when touched by love. A work about the moment inner strength wakes up and a person dares to open up.
soul-awakening.seo: surreal female portrait with red macaws

manifest-yourself.lead: A powerful woman musician in a whirl of fabric, wild energy and cinematic movement: a visual expression of courage, creation and bringing an idea to life. A bold accent that fills an interior, studio or living room with passion and creative energy.
story: “The limits of what you can manifest depend only on you. Whatever you can do or dream, begin it. Boldness has genius, power and magic in it. Begin now.”
There is a moment before everything changes: nothing is certain, but something inside says move. This work lives in exactly that moment.

The woman is immersed in music: she does not just play, she becomes it. The cello here is not an instrument but her voice. The explosion of colour, fabric and energy around her is what happens when creation is no longer held back. Beside her stand leopards, not danger but strength, a primal untamed energy within.
Manifestation begins not when everything is ready but at the moment you decide not to stay where you are any longer.
The only real limit is the one we refuse to cross. Sometimes everything changes the moment you simply begin.
manifest-yourself.meaning: Boldness has genius, power and magic in it: begin now. A work about the moment you decide not to wait for the perfect time and turn an idea into action.
manifest-yourself.seo: surreal art with a woman cellist

in-your-light.lead: A couple in a quiet, intimate moment among soft flowers, glow and warm cinematic tones: a symbol of love, connection and the inner light we find through another person. A work that brings warmth and emotional depth to a bedroom or living room.
story: “In your light I learn how to love. In your beauty, how to make poems.”

Some connections change not only what we feel but how we see. This work is about love that becomes light: not loud or demanding, but deeply present. A presence that quietly teaches, softens and reveals in us what we did not know.
“You dance inside my chest, where no one sees you… but sometimes I do, and that sight becomes art.”
The light between two figures is not just light. It is connection, presence, meaning. The strongest experiences are often invisible, yet they shape everything we create.
in-your-light.meaning: “In your light I learn how to love.” A work about love that becomes light: the quiet presence of another person who changes not only what we feel but how we see.
in-your-light.seo: romantic art with a couple’s silhouettes in warm light

depths-of-becoming.lead: A surreal image of a woman in deep turquoise water lit by golden light: a work about transformation and who we become when we dare to go deeper.
story: The depth frightens because it is quiet and there is nothing to hold on to. But it is exactly there that the most important thing happens: we stop clinging to the surface and begin to become ourselves.
The dark turquoise is the unknown we dive into. The golden light is what reveals itself in us in this very depth.
Where in your life are you invited to go deeper? This work is not only to decorate a space but to live with. Some works you look at. With others, you grow.
depths-of-becoming.meaning: We become ourselves when we dare to go deeper and let go of the surface. A work about the transformation that happens in silence and the unknown.
depths-of-becoming.seo: surreal art with a woman underwater in golden light

peace-of-mind.lead: A calm female figure among deep greenery and warm light: a work about inner peace, mindfulness and human depth. An accent that brings quiet and balance to a home.
story: This work is about a state in which thoughts fall silent and presence remains. Not an escape from the world but a quiet support within that holds even when everything around is restless.
The deep greenery is life growing slowly and surely. The warm light is a calm that does not depend on circumstances.
A collectible work for spaces where you want to stop and exhale.
peace-of-mind.meaning: Peace is not an escape from the world but a quiet support within. A work about mindfulness and an inner calm that holds even when everything around is restless.
peace-of-mind.seo: art about inner peace: a woman among greenery

god-is-fighting-for-us.lead: A Christian work about spiritual battle and God’s protection: an archangel in golden armour with outstretched wings among light, flowers and flames. Created in 2022 as a reminder that even in the darkest time we are not alone.
story: “The Lord will fight for you, and you only need to be still.” (Exodus 14:14)
The work was born in 2022, in a time of war, when questions of protection, faith and strength became personal for millions of people.

The archangel is an image of a heavenly protector and warrior of light standing between a person and the darkness. The golden armour and wings are God’s power and steadfastness, the flowers and light around him are life that continues even in the middle of the battle.
A reminder that the real battle is not fought only on earth, and that God fights for us.
god-is-fighting-for-us.meaning: “The Lord will fight for you, and you only need to be still.” A work created in 2022 about God’s protection and faith that even in the darkest time we are not alone.
god-is-fighting-for-us.seo: Christian art with an archangel: spiritual battle and protection

we-are-mosaics.lead: A surreal portrait about the beauty of healing and unity: the fragments of our lives come together into a fascinating whole. A black swan and a tiger, golden light shining through fractured lines, a stained-glass arch. A piece for a living room, study or bedroom, and a meaningful gift.
story: “We are all mosaics: pieces of light, love, history and stars glued together.”
This surreal composition explores the idea that every fracture in our journey is a place where light shines through, creating something brand new.
Fractured lines and light symbolise experiences we might consider “broken” but which actually become the foundation for a new, more complex beauty.
The black swan and the tiger represent the unity of opposites: grace and strength, calm and wild energy, coexisting within every soul.
The mosaic effect is a reminder that everything is connected, and everything has meaning if you look for it.
This is not just a print; it is a manifesto that you are a masterpiece, held together by magic, music and words.
we-are-mosaics.meaning: We are all mosaics: every fracture in our journey is a place where light shines through.
we-are-mosaics.seo: portrait of a woman with a black swan and a tiger in a stained-glass arch: a mosaic of light and fractures

bloom-with-grace.lead: A surreal underwater female figure among red fish, organic forms and the textures of ocean depth: a powerful story of transformation, resilience and beauty even in the deep. A work with emotional depth, mystery and bold presence.
story: “Bloom with grace wherever life plants you.”
Not every place we find ourselves looks like light. Sometimes it is depth, pressure, silence. This work was born from exactly such a space.

The woman is submerged beneath the surface, surrounded not by comfort but by the unknown. The red fish wraps around her as both strength and protection. The octopus becomes part of her form. Even fragile remains, bones, textures, fragments, turn into something alive and beautiful.
This is not about escaping the depth but about becoming yourself in it. Even in the deepest waters there is light above, and even there you can bloom.
We do not need perfect conditions to become who we are meant to be. Sometimes the depth itself becomes the place where we truly open up.
bloom-with-grace.meaning: Bloom with grace wherever life plants you. A work about the strength to become yourself even in the depth, under pressure and in the unknown, without losing softness.
bloom-with-grace.seo: surreal art with an underwater woman and a red fish

prepare-the-way-for-the-king.lead: A Christian Christmas work about the birth of Jesus: warm light, deep red and gold, animals by the manger. Created to inspire, deepen faith and bring spiritual meaning into everyday space.
story: “Prepare the way of the Lord, make His paths straight.” (Mark 1:3)
Christmas is the moment God comes into the world quietly, in simplicity, among ordinary things. This work invites you to pause before this mystery and prepare a place for Him in your heart.
The warm light at the centre is hope that comes into the darkness. Deep red and gold are the love and royal dignity of the Child born in a manger.
A reminder of the meaning of Christmas, not only for the holidays but every day.
prepare-the-way-for-the-king.meaning: “Prepare the way of the Lord.” A Christmas work about God coming into the world quietly and simply, and the place we prepare for Him in our heart.

waterline.lead: A surreal portrait about the boundary between the inner self and the outer world: water frozen at the level of the lips, crimson streaks upon dark skin and closed eyes. A work for anyone seeking a profound, philosophical accent for a study, living room or bedroom, and for collectors drawn to self-reflection.
story: “Waterline” is a visual confession about the boundary we draw between the self and the world. It captures a moment of frozen decision: to drown in one’s own truth or to remain on the surface at the cost of one’s voice.
The water’s edge represents social pressure and the fear of judgment. It acts as a barrier that silences the voice, turning expression into deeper immersion.
Crimson traces represent the “dark side” of the soul: concentrated energy, pain and the secrets we hide. They suggest an inner world too intense for the surface to comprehend.
Closed eyes are a symbol of absolute self-immersion. When the external world requires too much filtering, the subject chooses the sanctuary of the internal abyss.
The burden illustrates the crushing weight of thoughts that become leaden when there is no one to share them with.
waterline.meaning: The boundary between self and world: to drown in one’s own truth or to remain on the surface at the cost of one’s voice.
waterline.seo: portrait with closed eyes, crimson traces and water at the level of the lips
